name: car_manufacturers
label: Car manufacturers
provenance: Was 160 lines (159 unique) of mostly current global marques; grew it with real historical and defunct automobile marques - pre-war American independents, British and French coachbuilt makes, German and Italian pre-war firms, Soviet and Eastern-bloc plants, Japanese, Chinese, Indian and Korean makers, plus kit-car and supercar boutiques. Dropped one duplicate line (Skoda). Every addition is a marque I believe actually existed; none are invented. Confidence high, not checked against a source.
